description: Monthly commute cost between two Swiss places: by car at the official Swiss average fuel price (BFS) and by electric car at the home commune official electricity tariff (ElCom H4), plus the public-transport journey time (Swiss timetable). Distance defaults to straight line × 1.3 between the stations (labelled estimate) unless km_one_way is given. Public-transport fares are not open official data and are not included.

from.description: Home place: Swiss postcode or locality, e.g. "Winterthur" or "8400".

km_one_way.description: Road distance one way in km, e.g. 25; omit to use the routed distance between from and to.

to.description: Work place: Swiss postcode or locality, e.g. "Zürich" or "8001".

name: commute_cost
title: Commute cost
